generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch on SEA: Single Motor 51 kWh LFP (49 usable, DC 134 kW) and Extended Range / Twin 69 kWh NMC (64 usable, DC 153 kW). US last year 2026; Canada continues, so last_year is left open. North American cars may be mostly 69 kWh versions; check which packs were sold here. Production moved partly to Ghent in 2025 (same packs). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending).
